title: Penguin waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="68" rx="24" ry="28" fill="#3a4a8a"/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="16" ry="22" fill="#e8eef8"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="34" r="18" fill="#3a4a8a"/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="38" rx="13" ry="12" fill="#e8eef8"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="33" r="3.2" fill="#1a1a3a"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="33" r="3.2" fill="#1a1a3a"/>
  <circle cx="45" cy="32" r="1.1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="32" r="1.1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <polygon points="50,38 45,43 55,43" fill="#f5a623"/>
  <!-- left flipper (down) -->
  <ellipse cx="24" cy="66" rx="6" ry="14" fill="#2e3c75" transform="rotate(15 24 66)"/>
  <!-- right flipper (waving up) -->
  <ellipse cx="74" cy="54" rx="6" ry="14" fill="#2e3c75" transform="rotate(-40 74 54)"/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="95" rx="9" ry="4" fill="#f5a623"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="95" rx="9" ry="4" fill="#f5a623"/>
  <!-- little wave marks near flipper -->
  <path d="M82 38 q3 -3 6 0" stroke="#7ec8f5" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M84 32 q4 -4 8 0" stroke="#7ec8f5" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
